title: Amber Chamber
address: Bang Jo hills, Si Sunthon, Thalang, Phuket
shortDescription: A small hillside collection of private-pool villas in Bang Jo, Si Sunthon, with 3 and 4-bedroom homes.
description: Amber Chamber is a small hillside collection of private-pool villas in the Bang Jo area of Si Sunthon, Thalang, in northwest Phuket. The project comprises 3 and 4-bedroom homes of roughly 428 to 620 sqm built-up across the Essence, Serenity and Bliss designs. Listings describe it as under construction, with shared co-working, fitness and pet areas plus round-the-clock security. Unit counts, prices and handover timing differ between marketing sources.
